title: What if Earth stopped spinning? #shorts
description:
POV: you are in a city park when Earth suddenly stops spinning.

The facts: at the latitude of Europe the ground moves at roughly 1,000 km/h as Earth turns. If the planet stopped but the atmosphere kept moving, the wind would sweep across the surface at about that speed, far faster than any hurricane ever measured. The oceans would keep moving too. And without spinning, one day would last a whole year: about six months of daylight, then six months of night.
